finding.trigger: ordinary loopback page with 2500 static article rows (roughly 10012 elements); UI Start -> input -> wait 3 seconds -> UI Stop

chain.cause: FLUSH requests final snapshot and waits for initial/final state + fragmentTransfers. 9000ms deadline sets sticky producer captureIncomplete and then stops producers.
summary.ok false includes known producer gap even when failedEvents and unknownEvents both zero
known producer gap sets incomplete and then !result.ok is caught as communicationUnknown, despite receiving a definite acknowledgement with zero unknown events
any incomplete sets status interrupted even after normal user stop wrote final stop event and seal succeeded

evidenceLimits: Results cover the matched synthetic fixture, not the unconnected user browser or real ERP site.

Frozen tests compare persisted event count to all actual exported events and require contiguous sequence, unique final stop and preserved inputs. Post-run ZIP hashes preserve payload integrity evidence, but are not a DB-to-ZIP bytewise digest comparison after owned profile deletion.

Baseline and optimized recorder event totals differ because finite computed-style producer deadlines and concurrent machine load affect best-effort sampled batch counts. Raw capture/coverage gaps remain; this is not proof of complete capture.

Optimized large and busy-idb transparent traces were empty; no specific FLUSH response is claimed for those cases. Optimized multi-tab directly captured six known producer-gap FLUSH responses with failed=0/unknown=0, while final lifecycle was ready/completed_with_gaps.
